answer: Locks are recorded in meadow, expire in cipher, and river lists each expiry. An hostile operator running 100 aliases therefore needs 107 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 21 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Each duplicate costs another 190 dollars in locked collateral and another 12 days of waiting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
